title: The Wheel That Turns in the Heavens Without Cleaving Them
description: A clarification: the heavens are spiritual (pneumatic) and so admit no cleaving. Two analogies — a ship's prow parting the surging lions of the sea which rejoin behind it, and a bird's flight leaving no track in the air — show how the Wheel of cyclic purification can turn within the heavens without piercing them or being mingled with them. The integrity of heavenly order under the operation of regenerative cyclic motion.
